cases.question: How many weeks of parental leave are provided?
cases.answer: The parental leave policy provides sixteen weeks of leave.

candidates.text: General employee benefits include travel support and wellness allowances.
The parental leave policy provides sixteen weeks of paid parental leave.
Expense reports must be submitted within thirty days.

cases.question: How long are security incident records retained?
cases.answer: Security incident records are retained for seven years.

candidates.text: Security incident records are retained for seven years for audit and compliance.
Security incidents are triaged according to severity and containment impact.
Application logs use a shorter operational retention window.

cases.question: What enforces tenant isolation for vector search?
cases.answer: Vector search enforces a server-authoritative tenant payload filter on the shared collection.

candidates.text: Every vector operation on the shared Qdrant collection applies the authenticated tenant payload filter.
Qdrant stores dense vectors and supports snapshot recovery.
Service keys are scoped and persisted only as hashes.
